messages:
Maria G: Hey folks — opened a small PR to clarify how pricing tiers interact with rate limits and dashboard metrics. needs review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Kevin L: thanks — left a couple inline comments about the wording for 'burst allowance' vs 'burst window'. can we add a quick TS + curl example?
Maria G: yea plan is to add both. Alex, can you sanity-check the math on the example i added (tokens/min -> effective qps)?
Alex Chen: looking now. quick note: our quota resets are aligned to UTC minute boundaries, not rolling windows — call that out precisely.
Samir Patel: also suggest showing an edge case: reserved dedicated capacity ignores shared-tier burst caps. important for enterprise customers.
Maria G: good point. i'll add a short callout and an example header: `X-Redwood-Capacity: dedicated`
Kevin L: for TS snippet, use the new sdk v2 shape. example request should show `max_tokens` and `model` and then a note about billing rounding to 1 token for embeddings.
Alex Chen: minor nit — the dashboard panel name in the doc is "Requests / Minute" but in prod it's "Requests (per min)". that caused a couple of broken links in the docs.
Maria G: ugh — docs-bot CI flagged that. @docs-bot could you paste the failing link check?
docs-bot: link-checker: found 2 broken links in docs/usage/tiers.md line 78 and docs/analytics/panels.md line 22. see CI results: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/links/482
Samir Patel: for the metering examples, can we show a small table-like snippet demonstrating metered units: "1 text token = 1 unit; 1 embedding = 1 embed-unit" and how tiers apply? short, not formal table.
Maria G: yep i'll add a monospace block:
```
# example: minute metering math
requests:
  - 2 calls per minute, each 300 tokens => 600 tokens/min
  - tier A baseline 1000 tokens/min => charged baseline
  - burst 400 allowed => final accepted
```
Kevin L: also add a note about metering anomalies: long-running streaming requests sample differently (we measure produced tokens).
Alex Chen: i've pushed a tiny commit to fix the panel name and the two broken links (docs: panels.md -> match prod name). please re-run CI when ready.
Maria G: pushed updates, added TS + curl snippets, and the dedicated capacity callout. re-running link check now.
docs-bot: link-checker: all links valid. spell-check: 1 suggestion ("metre" -> "meter") 
Samir Patel: lgtm from me for content. maybe add an example of dashboard filter: `?range=30d&team=prod` so people know how to replicate charts.
Kevin L: approved, small wording tweak in the rate-limit paragraph — replace 'reset window' with 'reset boundary'.
Maria G: done. merging in a few mins unless anyone objects. thanks for quick reviews :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: no objections. thanks for coordinating.
Maria G: merged. I'll follow up with a short changelog entry for the announcements channel later today.
thread_summary: Docs PR to clarify pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage analytics; added TS/curl examples, fixed broken dashboard links, callouts for dedicated capacity, and CI link checks
